title: Prepare the operating activities section of the statement of cash flows using the indirect method

items.concept: Reconstruct period-end adjusting JEs (emphasis), disposal and bond-settlement JEs, supporting T-account schedules, and the full indirect-method operating activities section
Number-variant twin—indirect operating section; period-end discount amortization AJ (add); loss on PPE disposal; WC mixed signs
Period-end adjusting JE emphasis—record year-end AJs (depreciation, accruals, SBC, FV-NI, equity method, deferred taxes) and translate each into the correct indirect-method add/subtract
Classification/presentation — bond premium amortization and decrease in inventory under the indirect method
Period-end adjusting JE for accrued salaries and its single correct SCF effect
